Alger, 8 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 8, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Algerian capital will host the 5th edition of the African Startup Conference from December 5 to 7, focusing on the theme of deeptech and the continent's technological sovereignty. More than 400 exhibitors and 25,000 visitors are expected under the high patronage of President Abdelmadjid Tebboune.
Organisation de la 5e Conférence africai: Organization of the 5th African Startup Conference in Algiers
Lors d'une séance d'information réunissa: During an information session bringing together African diplomats and representatives of international organizations accredited in Algeria, the Minister of Knowledge Economy, Start-ups and Micro-enterprises, Noureddine Ouadah, unveiled the main lines of this continental gathering. The event, organized under the slogan "Deeptech… a real challenge", aims to bring together decision-makers, researchers, investors and entrepreneurs around the issues of scientific research and advanced engineering.
Le sommet ministériel, prévu durant ces: The ministerial summit, scheduled during these three days of work, is expected to gather between 35 and 40 African ministers in charge of telecommunications, innovation or innovative enterprises. According to the Director of Start-ups and Support Structures at the Ministry, Chemseddine Benmoussat, discussions will focus on public support for deeptech startups and the contribution of advanced technologies to meet the continent's specific challenges. The event will benefit from the support of partner organizations such as the African Union, the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) and the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA).
